source_audit_support.local_source_safe_action: Question text, options, answer, rationale, and citation rewritten to remove the degenerate options and correct the propagated 'Certificate of Use' error.

proposed.text: After a change of use application is approved under Sec. 702, what specific occupancy authorization does the Building Official issue under Rule III Sec. 309?

options.text: An amended Building Permit that retroactively changes the original new-construction permit to reflect the new use
An additional Certificate of Occupancy, issued because Sec. 309(c) expressly provides for other Certificates of Occupancy due to changes in use
A separate 'Certificate of Use', a distinct instrument that the IRR created specifically for existing-building conversions
A Fire Safety Clearance issued by the Bureau of Fire Protection, which alone authorizes the new occupancy classification

proposed.rationale: Sec. 309(c) of the PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR provides that a building that already holds a Certificate of Occupancy may be issued OTHER Certificates of Occupancy due to changes in use, whether partly or wholly, if the new use conforms to the Code and its IRR. The term 'Certificate of Use' does not appear anywhere in PD 1096 or its IRR; the correct instrument is a Certificate of Occupancy.
proposed.explanation: There is a single instrument family — the Certificate of Occupancy. New construction draws an initial CO; a later change of use draws an additional CO under Sec. 309(c). Option (c) is the propagating error: 'Certificate of Use' is not a document recognized by PD 1096.
